answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit and build a verifiable work history before it can trade at full limits. New identities start with tiny quotas, like a glacier moving slowly, and only earn larger quotas after sustained honest service. Sybil farms cannot cheaply copy that history: an onyx-grade audit trail ties reputation to proven work, while a jade-level peer check samples past transactions before granting trust. Creating thousands of fresh identities therefore costs time and stake without buying real reputation.
